parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

useNodeCloudIdentity.description: If true query and use current compute instance's Cloud Identity (e.g. AWS IAM Role).

accessKey.description: Active Directory Client ID. This is the application id of the app registered in AD.

secretKey.description: Active Directory Client Secret. This key is created during app registration.

endpoint.description: Endpoint for accessing resources (e.g. Kubernetes API server endpoint).

description.description: Customized description for the cloud resource credential.

certificate.description: Tls Certificate if this Cloud Resource needs a secure connection

activeDirectoryId.description: Active Directory ID. In some azure documents this is referred to as tenant id.

secretKeyExpiration.description: The date and time at which the client secret expires.

sasBlobEndpoint.description:
The Azure sasBlobEndpoint. Default is blob.core.windows.net. For specific deployments, this may need to be set in
order to have the sasUrl populated in {@link AzureFile}

adminUsername.description: The administrator's login name of a server when it is required for resource creation.

adminPassword.description: The password of the administrator login, used together with #adminUsername for resource creation.

partnerId.description:
The partner id usually represented as a GUID/UUID that is registered with Azure to facilitate partner resource
usage attribution.
format: pid-XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX

accessToken.description: Access Token for your MS Graph app.

refreshToken.description: Refresh Token for your MS Graph app.

refreshTokenExpiration.description: The date and time at which the refresh token expires.

scopes.description: Scopes are the permissions that the application needs. These must be supplied to the client when it is created.

loginEndpoint.description: Login endpoint to use when generating access token/refresh token

title: Microsoft Graph Service credentials used to access services through the Microsoft Graph Service Client
name: MsGraphCredentials
